method: Owner-operated scoped API roundtrip; selective commits include only the p3- Notebook.
steps: Create an isolated branch with no existing item definitions
Create a temporary repo-scoped GitHub credential connection
Create one p3- Notebook in Shape Test
Selectively commit only the p3- Notebook
